''' Akif Jafar Hajiyev''' ({{langx|az|Akif Cəfər oğlu Hacıyev}}, 8 December 1937 – 3 February 2015) was an [[Azerbaijan Republic|Azerbaijani]] mathematician. He served as the vice-president of the [[Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences]] from 2013 until his death.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://mechmath.bsu.edu.az/az/content/akademik_akif__cfr_olu_hacyev__687|title=Bakı Dövlət Universiteti|author=Adil Aliyev}}</ref> From 2004 to 2013, he was the director of the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics of the National Academy of Sciences. He authored four books, in addition to numerous papers. By presidential decree, he was awarded the "[[Shohrat Order|Order of Glory]]" in 2004 and "Honored Worker of Science" in 2005.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://az.trend.az/azerbaijan/politics/2360564.html|title=Akif Hacıyevin vəfatı ilə əlaqədar rəsmi nekroloq imzalandı|date=4 February 2015|work=Trend.Az|access-date=13 July 2018|archive-date=4 July 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150704114114/http://az.trend.az/azerbaijan/politics/2360564.html|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=International conference dedicated to Academician Akif Hajiyev's 80th anniversary closed |url=http://isi.az/en/news/532 |access-date=2018-07-13}}</ref> He became the president of the Azerbaijan Mathematical Society in 2010.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Hajiyev Akif Jafar oglu |url=https://science.gov.az/en/forms/skonchavshiesya-deystvitelnyie-chlenyi/2617 |access-date=2024-07-10 |website=science.gov.az}}</ref>

A native of Baku, Hajiyev was best known for his work in the theory of multidimensional singular integrals.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://report.az/en/education-and-science/anas-vice-president-akif-hajiyev-dies/|title=Vice-President of Azerbaijan Sciences Academy Akif Hajiyev dies|work=Report News Agency|access-date=2018-07-13|language=en}}</ref>
